imageNote: All three images are real Flow Builder canvas screenshots from Trailhead's 'Loops in Flow Builder' module, hosted on Trailhead's own Cloudinary CDN (res.cloudinary.com/hy4kyit2a/...). Trailhead's article content is server-rendered but images load through LWC shadow DOM, so URLs were pulled from the live DOM via the browser tool's deep shadow-root query rather than a plain curl of the HTML. Each image was verified with a full curl GET (not HEAD) confirming a genuine image byte stream, and viewed with the Read tool before writing captions. The 100-SOQL-query / 150-DML-operation flow limits and the 'Get Records before, Create/Update/Delete after' guidance are taken directly from the Trailhead unit text, not assumed from general Salesforce knowledge.
